verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a Workflow SDK explicitly for building 'durable, observable applications and AI agents' on a fully managed platform, directly matching the story of deploying durable workflows as code without manually wiring queues/retries, and this is complemented by Fluid compute for scaling concurrency. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of retry semantics or durability guarantees, no detail on how queuing is abstracted, and no community corroboration of real-world reliability.
